title: Configuration Surgery
story: Debug logging made it into the Friday release. It is producing one gigabyte of confidence-destroying detail every few minutes.
objective: Change LOG_LEVEL=debug to LOG_LEVEL=info inside /etc/byteworks/app.env while preserving every other line.
hints: The -i option writes the transformed text back to the file.
explanation: sed can apply a targeted substitution without rebuilding a whole configuration file. A narrow match reduces the chance of modifying unrelated settings.
